page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between the instance and external storage volumes or other network resources. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the hardware profile entirely on memory-intensive CPU workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.16xlarge offers high resource density for workloads that require large memory footprints without the overhead of GPU hardware. It is designed for memory-intensive applications such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data caching layers, and complex data analytics pipelines that fit entirely within system memory.
